sections.title: It’s been a while, and that’s okay.
sections.sub: If it’s been years since your last visit, you won’t be judged for it. Whatever brought you here, we start with where things stand today.
items: You haven’t seen a dentist in years
Life got busy, or the last visit put you off. We start fresh, with no lectures.
You’re nervous about the dentist
Agree a stop signal, take it at your pace, and ask about sedation if you need it.
Something doesn’t feel quite right
Sensitivity, a chip, a filling that’s seen better days. Better looked at now than later.
You want to know the cost first
Every recommendation comes with a written price before anything begins.
You want the same dentist each time
You can ask to see the same dentist at every visit.
You’re looking for a family dentist
Parents can stay throughout children’s appointments, and child check-ups are £20.

card.title: What happens afterwards?
card.text: If everything is healthy, we’ll recommend how often to come back and how to look after your teeth at home. If you need treatment, you’ll leave with a written plan showing what we recommend, why, and what it costs. There’s no pressure to decide on the day.

items: How much does a dental examination cost?
An adult check-up, including X-rays, is currently £25 (usually £50). Children aged 0 to 12 are £20. Our membership plans include check-ups from £9.99 a month.
Do I need to be an existing patient to book?
No. New patients are welcome and don’t need a referral.
Will I have X-rays at my examination?
Only where they’re clinically necessary. We’ll always explain why we recommend one before taking it.
What if I am nervous about attending?
Let us know when you book and we’ll go at your pace. Sedation is also available at the practice for patients who need extra support.
How often should I have a dental examination?
For most patients, every six to twelve months. We’ll advise on the right interval for you based on the health of your teeth and gums.
Can I see the same dentist each time?
Yes. You can ask to see the same dentist at every visit.
